subject: Question about excursion package with INLA

messages.author: dde40b6e9b2ec6e4
messages.subject: Question about excursion package with INLA
parts:
I am trying to use excursion.inla to obtain results about the joint exceedance probability, but when I try to use this I obtain the following error:


> exc <- excursions.inla(res, stk.full, tag = "pred", u = 1, u.link = TRUE,
+                       type = ">", F.lim = 0.6, method = 'QC')
Error en .M2C(.bdiag(list(...))):
  'R_Calloc' could not allocate memory (503005637 of 4 bytes)


Is there any mistake or maybe my computer does not have enough memory? This is the model


formula <- y ~ -1 + b0 + ind + mar + agric + f(s, model = spde)

res <- inla(formula, family = "lognormal",
            data = inla.stack.data(stk.full),
            control.predictor = list(A = inla.stack.A(stk.full), compute = TRUE),
            control.compute = list(cpo = TRUE, dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE,
                                   return.marginals.predictor = TRUE,
                                   config = TRUE),
            control.fixed=list(mean = 0,prec = 0.01,
                               mean.intercept = 0,prec.intercept = 0.01))


Thank you for the help

messages.author: 2a6271869edfdebb
messages.subject: Re: Question about excursion package with INLA
parts: Hi Daniel, I have never seen that error before, but it indeed looks like a memory problem. It is trying to allocate about 4Gb of memory and cannot. Make sure that you have enough RAM available when calling the function, and you can also try reducing the size of the model to see if that helps. If it does not help, I can take a look at it.
